scientific_integrity: The dense coefficient recursion is mathematically proved. Exhaustive checks on small trees are separate corroboration, not an infinite-domain certificate. No independent audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Connected simple undirected trees only; the arithmetic \(O(n^2)\) bound is not a bit complexity bound. Complete priority and external validation are unverified; earlier published spider-family counting is acknowledged.
title: Quadratic-time enumeration of edge general-position sets in arbitrary trees
